lens.formula: portfolio_fit = 100 x sqrt(Viability x Opportunity) x privacy_factor x audience_factor
lens.viability: (0.35 aibuild + 0.25 legal + 0.20 build + 0.20 maint)/5  (build, maint, legal are inverted rubric criteria: 5 = easiest/safest)
lens.opportunity: (0.25 pain_adj + 0.25 wtp + 0.25 distro + 0.10 breadth + 0.15 monetisation_fit)/5; pain_adj = pain +0.5 if CFS>=2.5, +0.25 if CFS>=2.0 (cap 5); monetisation_fit = recurring if >=3 else 3 if wtp>=3 else 2

privacy_classes.A: Fully local/on-device (IndexedDB/OPFS, files, PWA or native)
privacy_classes.B: Local + user-owned sync (iCloud/Drive/Dropbox file) or E2E-encrypted blobs the server cannot read
privacy_classes.C-redesign: As specced needs server-held personal data; documented redesign to A/B
privacy_classes.C-disq: Core value needs server-held personal data -> disqualified under the zero-private-data rule

lens.tiers: Build now = roadmap slots 1-2; Next = slots 3-6 incl. Pass modules; Later = slots 7-8 or fit>=68; Feeder = free lead-magnet tools; Park = C-disq or fit<68

roadmap.name: GiftLedger (Christmas & birthday gift list + budget)
roadmap.price: Free: 1 list, 10 people. Lifetime unlock A$19 (launch A$12 until 31 Dec). Later included in the Life Admin Pass.
roadmap.why: Highest rubric total (83.4), fully local, tiny build, and Christmas 2026 is a hard seasonal window 4-8 weeks away. Proves the template + checkout + licence key end-to-end.
roadmap.metrics: Ship by 20 Nov; >=1,500 visitors and >=40 paid unlocks by 31 Dec; refund rate <5%; >=150 email opt-ins.
roadmap.kill: <10 paid by 15 Dec despite 3 posts/week -> freeze features, keep as free Pass feeder.

roadmap.name: TimeAudit (.ics calendar time audit)
roadmap.price: Free: last 4 weeks summary. Lifetime A$19 (launch A$15): full year, categories, PDF report, compare periods.
roadmap.why: #2 by rubric, CFS 2.8 (frequent complaint), zero server data (file parsed in browser), and January 'year in review / reset' demand; the user named it.
roadmap.metrics: >=2,000 visitors/mo by Feb; free->paid >=2%; 1 programmatic page per calendar app ranking top-20.
roadmap.kill: <25 paid by end Feb 2027 -> keep free as lead magnet; do not build the Google Calendar version.

roadmap.name: HolidayPlanner AU (school holiday & leave planner)
roadmap.launch: early Feb 2027 (before Term 1 Easter/April holiday bookings)
roadmap.price: Free planner for one state/year. A$15/yr per family (launch A$9 first year): both parents' leave, all states, .ics export, printable. Becomes a Pass module.
roadmap.why: Recurring by nature (term dates change every year = real ongoing value), AU-specific SEO (state x year x term pages), CFS 2.75; first module of the Life Admin Pass.
roadmap.metrics: State x year SEO pages indexed; >=60 paid families by June 2027; annual renewal intent (survey) >=50%.
roadmap.kill: <30 paid by end April 2027 -> fold into the Pass as a free feature only.

roadmap.name: SeatPlan (drag-and-drop wedding seating planner)
roadmap.launch: May 2027 (ahead of AU spring wedding season Sept-Nov)
roadmap.price: Free up to 40 guests. A$39 per wedding (one-time, launch A$29). Planner/venue licence A$99/yr later.
roadmap.why: User's favourite idea, strong Pinterest/wedding distribution, CFS 2.55, local-first guest list. Hardest UI so it comes after the template is mature.
roadmap.metrics: >=100 paid events in first 6 months; Pinterest >=5k monthly impressions; >=2 venue/planner partners.
roadmap.kill: <40 paid by Oct 2027 -> stop new features, keep selling; skip the RSVP hub.

roadmap.name: BedPlanner AU (vegetable garden bed planner for AU climates)
roadmap.price: Free: 1 bed. A$29/yr (launch A$19) or A$59 lifetime: unlimited beds, AU climate-zone planting calendar, succession reminders via .ics.
roadmap.why: Seasonal recurring use (every spring/autumn), AU climate zones are a moat vs US tools, local-only data. Launch timing = AU spring.
roadmap.metrics: >=150 paying by Dec 2027; >=35% choose annual; organic Pinterest/Reddit (r/AusGardening) traffic.
roadmap.kill: <50 paying by Nov 2027 -> sell as lifetime only and stop content updates.

roadmap.name: Life Admin Pass (bundle: renewals, bills, insurance creep, warranties + slots 1 & 3)
roadmap.price: A$29/yr per household (launch A$19 for existing buyers). Includes GiftLedger + HolidayPlanner; standalone buyers get credit.
roadmap.why: Run 5 bundle (68.8). Built last of the core because it reuses the storage layer, .ics engine, licence keys and the customer list from slots 1 and 3.
roadmap.metrics: >=300 households by Mar 2028; 12-month renewal >=60%; >=25% of earlier buyers upgrade.
roadmap.kill: <120 households by Feb 2028 -> sell modules individually.

roadmap.name: RunSheet (event run-sheet builder) + seating cross-sell
roadmap.price: A$19 per event or A$59/yr for planners/MCs.
roadmap.why: Same Events family code (timeline, print, share-as-PDF) and same buyers as SeatPlan; cross-sell inside the seating app.
roadmap.metrics: >=20% of SeatPlan buyers add RunSheet; >=50 standalone sales in 3 months.
roadmap.kill: <15% attach rate -> keep as a SeatPlan feature, no separate marketing.

roadmap.name: (Optional) TakeoutFixer: Google Photos Takeout date/GPS fixer
roadmap.price: Free preview of 100 photos; A$29 one-time.
roadmap.why: Different audience (global, evergreen), purely client-side (File System Access API), CFS 2.6. Optional slot if time allows; Chromium-desktop only.

assumptions: ASSUMPTIONS ONLY - not forecasts, no market data behind visitor counts.
Visitors/month at maturity per app: low/base/high as listed per app; reached via a linear 6-month ramp from launch.
Seasonality multipliers: gifts x3 Nov-Dec, x0.4 otherwise; time audit x1.8 Jan; school holidays x1.5 in Jan/Mar/Jun/Sep; garden x1.6 Mar/Aug/Sep; weddings x1.3 Aug-Oct.

Net per sale = price x (1 - 5% - 0.45% blended intl-card surcharge) - A$0.75 (~US$0.50); MoR remits GST from the gross, so prices are GST-inclusive and GST is not modelled separately (simplification).
Annual subscriptions booked at purchase; renewals not modelled inside the 18-month window (all fall after it except a few Pass/holiday renewals).
No paid ads, no lifetime-deal sites, no app-store revenue.

redesign.title: Christmas/holiday hosting planner: who hosts, who brings what

redesign.title: Wedding guest list, RSVP & budget hub (upsell of the seating planner)

redesign.title: Event run-sheet / cue-sheet builder with live share link

redesign.title: Ad-free party invite page + RSVP link

redesign.title: Ad-free team availability & roster for adult social sport

redesign.title: SSL certificate, domain expiry & DNS change monitor
